items.item_text: What is the Adoption Date of the document?
items.answer: Effective July 1, 1976; Original Instrument Executed July 1, 1978.

references.excerpt: Effective July 1, 1976, the College adopted the Plan.

items.item_text: What is the Plan Anniversary?

references.excerpt: Plan Year: The 12-Month Period Commencing On July 1.

items.item_text: What are the groups of employees covered under the plan?
items.answer: Non-Contract Employees Excluding Faculty And Administrative Employees Covered Under Another Pension Plan.

references.excerpt: Employee: Any Person, Exclusive Of Faculty And Administrative Employees Who Are Included In Another Pension Plan.

items.item_text: What are the participation eligibility requirements in the plan?
items.answer: Attained Age 25 And Completed A 12-Month Period With At Least 1,000 Hours Of Service; Excludes Hires After The First Of The Month Coincident With Or Following Age 60.

references.excerpt: An Employee Shall Become A Participant... Both Attained Age 25 And Completed A 12-Month Period... Not Less Than 1,000 Hours Of Service.

items.item_text: What is the participation date after attainment of eligibility in the plan?
items.answer: Earliest January 1 Or July 1 On Which Age 25 And 1,000 Hours In The Applicable 12-Month Period Are Satisfied.

references.excerpt: Participation... Shall Commence As Of The Earliest January 1 Or July 1 As Of Which He Had Both Attained Age 25 And Completed... 1,000 Hours.

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for normal retirement in the plan?

references.excerpt: Normal Retirement Date: The First Day Of The Calendar Month Coincident With Or Next Following The Participant's 65th Birthday.

items.item_text: What is the Start Date for normal retirement in the plan?
items.answer: First Day Of The Month Coincident With Or Next Following Retirement After Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Payment Of A Normal Retirement Pension Shall Commence As Of The First Day Of The Month Coinciding With Or Next Following The Date Of Retirement.

items.item_text: What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for Early Unreduced benefit retirement in the plan?
What is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for Early Reduced benefit retirement in the plan?

references.excerpt: Terminated On Or After His 60th Birthday And After He Has Completed 10 Or More Years Of Service.

items.item_text: What is the Start Date for early retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Normal Retirement Date Unless Committee Permits Earlier First Of Month Coincident With Or Next Following Retirement Or Later Requested Month Before Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: Payment... Shall Commence As Of The Participant's Normal Retirement Date... Or As Of The First Day Of Any Subsequent Month Which Precedes His Normal Retirement Date.

items.item_text: For Deferred vested, not eligible to retire as of date of termination, what is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for normal retirement in the plan?

references.excerpt: Deferred Vested Pension... Commencing As Of His Normal Retirement Date.

items.item_text: For Deferred vested, not eligible to retire as of date of termination, what is the Age/Service retirement eligibility for early retirement in the plan?
items.answer: With 10 Years Of Service, May Request Commencement During The 5-Year Period Before Normal Retirement Date, Reduced Under §5.2.

references.excerpt: Such A Participant Who Has Credit For 10 Or More Years Of Service May Request... Any Calendar Month Within The 5-Year Period Preceding His Normal Retirement Date.

items.item_text: What is the retirement eligibility for late retirement in the plan?
items.answer: Employment May Continue After Age 65 By Agreement; No Pension Payments During Continued Employment After Age 65.

references.excerpt: Participant Shall Cease To Be An Employee On His Normal Retirement Date Unless He And The Employer Agree That He Shall Continue His Employment After Attaining Age 65.

items.item_text: What is the eligibility requirement for disability under the plan?

references.excerpt: There Shall Be No Disability Benefits Under The Plan.

items.item_text: How the plan defines Eligibility/Participation service?
items.answer: A Year Of Service Is A Plan Year, Including Initial Eligibility Period, With At Least 1,000 Hours Of Service.

references.excerpt: Participant Shall Accrue A Year Of Service For Each Plan Year Including The Initial Eligibility Period In Which He Has 1,000 Or More Hours Of Service.

items.item_text: How the plan defines vesting service?
items.answer: A Year Of Service For Vesting Is Credited For A Plan Year Or Initial Eligibility Period With At Least 1,000 Hours; Eligibility Year Also Counts For Vesting.

references.excerpt: Employee Shall Receive Credit For A Year Of Service For Vesting Purposes If He Completes A Year Of Service For Eligibility Purposes.

items.item_text: How the plan defines benefit service?
items.answer: Same Service Definition Used For Eligibility And Benefit Amount; A Year Is Credited For Each Plan Year With At Least 1,000 Hours, Subject To Break-In-Service Rules.

references.excerpt: Eligibility For Benefits Under The Plan And The Amount Of The Benefit... Shall Be Determined By His Period Of Service.

items.item_text: Does the plan defines other type of service besides eligibility/participation, vesting and benefit service?
items.answer: Military Service Leave Does Not Constitute A Break In Service If Return Requirements Are Met.

references.excerpt: An Authorized Leave Of Absence Due To Service In The Armed Forces... Shall Not Constitute A Break In Service.

items.item_text: What is the accrued benefit formula under the plan?
items.answer: Monthly Life Pension Equals 1% Of Average Monthly Compensation Times Actual Years Of Service.

references.excerpt: Monthly Amount... For Life Shall Be Equal To 1% Of The Participant's Average Monthly Compensation Multiplied By His Actual Number Of Years Of Service.

items.item_text: What is the Accrual factor in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: 1% Of Average Monthly Compensation Per Year Of Service.

references.excerpt: Equal To 1% Of The Participant's Average Monthly Compensation Multiplied By His Actual Number Of Years Of Service.

items.item_text: What is the Short service factor in the accrued benefit formula?
What compensation is used in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: Total Salary And Wages Paid By The Employer For Personal Services Rendered During Service.

references.excerpt: Compensation: The Total Salary And Wages Paid To A Participant By The Employer For Personal Services Rendered During The Period Considered As Service.

items.item_text: How the plan defines average compensation to use in the accrued benefit formula?
items.answer: Average Monthly Compensation Equals Highest 5 Consecutive Years Of Compensation Before Retirement Or Earlier Termination Divided By 60.

references.excerpt: Dividing The Total Compensation... During The 5 Consecutive Years Which Will Produce The Highest Total Salary... By 60.

What is the Primary Insurance Amount (PIA) Offset in the plan?
If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Initial Account Balance in the plan?
If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, How the the plan defines Benefit Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, How the the plan defines Interest Credit in the Cash Balance Account?
If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Timing of Interest Credit in the Cash Balance Account?

If the plan is a Cash-Balance plan, What is the Annuity Conversion Method in the Cash Balance Account?
If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the eligibility for those?
If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the amount?
If there are Supplemental Benefits in the plan, What is the Duration?
What is the Normal Single Form of benefit as defined in the plan?
items.answer: Life Annuity For Deferred Vested Or Unmarried Participants; Married Normal Or Early Retirees Default To 50% Joint And Survivor Pension.

references.excerpt: If... Married For At Least One Year... Pension Shall Be Paid In The Form Of A 50% Joint And Survivor Pension.

items.item_text: What is the Normal Married Form of benefit as defined in the plan?
items.answer: 50% Joint And Survivor Pension For Participant Married At Least One Year At Commencement And Entitled To Normal Or Early Retirement At Or After Age 60.

references.excerpt: Paid In The Form Of A 50% Joint And Survivor Pension.

items.item_text: What is the Basis for Form Conversion Factors as defined in the plan?
items.answer: Optional Forms Are Actuarial Equivalent Based On Committee-Approved Assumptions.

references.excerpt: Actuarial Equivalent... Based On Actuarial Assumptions Approved From Time To Time By The Committee.

items.item_text: How the plan calculates the Early Retirement Adjustment?
items.answer: Reduced By 1/15 For Each Year Early Before Normal Retirement Date, With Pro Rata Reduction For Fractional Years.

references.excerpt: Reduced By 1/15th For Each Year That The Commencement Date... Precedes The Participant's Normal Retirement Date.

items.item_text: How the plan calculates the Late Retirement Adjustment?
items.answer: No Payments During Continued Employment After Age 65; Prior Payments On Reemployment Before Normal Retirement Date Offset On An Actuarial Equivalent Basis.

references.excerpt: No Pension Payments Shall Be Made During The Period Of Continued Employment.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Suspension of Benefit Provisions?
items.answer: No Pension Payments During Employment After Age 65 Or Reemployment Before Normal Retirement Date.

references.excerpt: If A Participant Continues In The Employer's Employ After He Attains Age 65, No Pension Payments Shall Be Made.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Disability Benefit Provisions?

references.excerpt: There Shall Be No Disability Benefits Under The Plan.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Pre-Retirement Death Benefits?
items.answer: Pre-Retirement 50% Joint And Survivor Coverage For Eligible Spouse If Participant Dies Before Retirement And Normal Retirement Date After Coverage Effective Date.

references.excerpt: If He Dies Prior To Retirement And Prior To His Normal Retirement Date But After The Coverage Effective Date, His Eligible Spouse Will Be Entitled To Receive A Pension.

items.item_text: What are, if any, the Post-Retirement Death Benefits?
items.answer: Post-Retirement Death Benefits Follow The Elected Form; 50% Joint And Survivor, Period Certain And Life, Or Contingent Annuitant Options May Continue Payments.

references.excerpt: Eligible Spouse... Lifetime Survivorship Pension... Equal To 50% Of The Reduced Monthly Amount.

items.item_text: What is the Vesting Schedule included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
What is the Cash-out Provisions included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
What is the One-Year Break In Service included in the Provisions for Deferred Participants?
items.answer: One-Year Break In Service Means A Plan Year With Not More Than 500 Hours Of Service; Nonvested Pre-Break Service May Be Disregarded If Consecutive Breaks Equal Or Exceed Prior Service.

references.excerpt: One-Year Break In Service Means A Plan Year During Which The Participant Has Not Completed More Than 500 Hours Of Service.

items.item_text: What are the Transfer Provisions defined in the plan?
items.answer: Plan Merger Or Asset Transfer Requires Each Participant To Receive A Benefit At Least Equal To The Pre-Transfer Benefit, Authorized Resolutions, And Qualified Receiving Plan And Trust.

references.excerpt: Assets... Shall Be Transferred... Only If Each Participant Would... Receive A Benefit... Equal To Or Greater Than... Before The Merger.

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), How the plan defines its Contributions?
items.answer: No Participant Contributions Are Required Or Permitted.

references.excerpt: No Contributions Shall Be Required Or Permitted Under The Plan From Any Participant.

items.item_text: If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), How the plan defines its Interest?
If the plan has Mandatory Employee Contributions (EEC), What provisions are in place  If EEC Withdrawn?
What are the Voluntary Provisions defined in the plan, if any?
Was the plan Top-Heavy?
Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit applies to key employees in addition to non-key employees?
How plan defines Top-Heavy Service?
How plan defines Top-Heavy Average Compensation?
How plan defines Top-Heavy Minimum Benefit Formula?
How plan defines Top-Heavy Vesting?
How plan defines Default Actuarial Equivalence?
items.answer: Equality In Value Of Aggregate Amounts Expected Under Different Forms Of Payment Based On Committee-Approved Actuarial Assumptions.

references.excerpt: Actuarial Equivalent... Equality In Value... Based On Actuarial Assumptions Approved From Time To Time By The Committee.

items.item_text: How plan defines Consensual Lump Sum Provisions?
Are there any Additional Provisions of Note?
items.answer: Benefit Limits For 25 Highest-Paid Employees Apply If Anticipated Annual Pension Exceeds $1,500 And Certain Termination Or Funding Conditions Occur.

references.excerpt: Restrictions On Benefits Payable To Highly Compensated Participants.
